mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS trendyId, u.user_id AS userId, COUNT(DISTINCT u.sku_id) AS skuCount, t.reward_type AS rewardType, t.reward_value AS rewardValue, t.trendy_name AS trendyName FROM shop_trendy_box_user u JOIN shop_product_sku s ON s.id = u.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 JOIN shop_product p ON p.id = s.product_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 JOIN shop_trendy t ON t.id = p.section_id AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status = 1 AND t.reward_type IN (1, 2, 3) AND t.reward_value <> '' JOIN ( SELECT p2.section_id AS section_id, COUNT(*) AS total_sku FROM shop_product_sku s2 JOIN shop_product p2 ON p2.id = s2.product_id AND p2.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s2.is_deleted = 0 AND p2.section_id = #{trendyId} GROUP BY p2.section_id ) tt ON tt.section_id = t.id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.sku_id IS NOT NULL AND u.user_id = #{userId} AND t.id = #{trendyId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shop_trendy_collect_record r WHERE r.trendy_id = t.id AND r.user_id = u.user_id AND r.is_deleted = 0) GROUP BY t.id, t.trendy_name, t.reward_type, t.reward_value, u.user_id, tt.total_sku HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT u.sku_id) >= tt.total_sku AND tt.total_sku > 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id AS trendyId, t.trendy_name AS trendyName, t.cover_image AS coverImage, t.description AS description, t.reward_type AS rewardType, t.reward_value AS rewardValue, COALESCE(tt.total_sku, 0) AS totalSku, COALESCE(x.collected_sku, 0) AS collectedSku, r.id AS recordId, r.collect_time AS collectTime, r.reward_desc AS rewardDesc FROM shop_trendy t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.section_id AS section_id, COUNT(*) AS total_sku FROM shop_product_sku s JOIN shop_product p ON p.id = s.product_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND p.section_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.section_id ) tt ON tt.section_id = t.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.section_id AS section_id, COUNT(DISTINCT u.sku_id) AS collected_sku FROM shop_trendy_box_user u JOIN shop_product_sku s ON s.id = u.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 JOIN shop_product p ON p.id = s.product_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.sku_id IS NOT NULL AND u.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY p.section_id ) x ON x.section_id = t.id LEFT JOIN shop_trendy_collect_record r ON r.trendy_id = t.id AND r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(x.collected_sku, 0) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, COALESCE(x.collected_sku, 0) DESC, t.id ASC

SELECT x.*, COALESCE(tt.total_sku, 0) AS totalSku FROM ( SELECT u.user_id AS userId, su.nickname AS userName, su.mobile AS mobile, COUNT(DISTINCT u.sku_id) AS collectedSku, MAX(r.id) AS recordId, MAX(r.collect_time) AS collectTime, MAX(r.reward_type) AS rewardType, MAX(r.reward_desc) AS rewardDesc FROM shop_trendy_box_user u JOIN shop_product_sku s ON s.id = u.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 JOIN shop_product p ON p.id = s.product_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN shop_trendy_collect_record r ON r.trendy_id = #{trendyId} AND r.user_id = u.user_id AND r.is_deleted = 0
u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.sku_id IS NOT NULL AND p.section_id = #{trendyId}
AND (su.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR su.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR su.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY u.user_id, su.nickname, su.mobile ) x
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sku FROM shop_product_sku s2 JOIN shop_product p2 ON p2.id = s2.product_id AND p2.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s2.is_deleted = 0 AND p2.section_id = #{trendyId} ) tt ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY x.collectedSku DESC, x.userId ASC

SELECT s.id AS skuId, p.id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, s.spec_text AS specText, s.sku_image AS skuImage, MIN(u.create_time) AS drawnTime FROM shop_product_sku s JOIN shop_product p ON p.id = s.product_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_trendy_box_user u ON u.sku_id = s.id AND u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND p.section_id = #{trendyId} GROUP BY s.id, p.id, p.product_name, s.spec_text, s.sku_image ORDER BY p.id ASC, s.sort ASC, s.id ASC
